_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Cluster remains mid-Complacency with subdued funding and canceled extremes; base-rate supports skilled HOLD until a range break clears.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on phase and only describes oil/VIX/yields rising
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds recent range, F&G ~45-55, funding stays subdued
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break with ETF flows sharply higher (up toward Disbelief) or crowded-long unwind plus support break (down toward Anxiety)
